title: Decor Setup-to-Takedown Duration
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=festive:lights
| stats earliest(_time) as setup_time latest(_time) as takedown_time by season
| eval days_up=round((takedown_time-setup_time)/86400,1)
| sort - days_up
description: Measures how long seasonal decor actually stays up each year.
value: Knowing the real setup-to-takedown duration helps put energy use, effort, and joy into the same frame.
implementation: Use first and last festive-light events as rough setup and takedown boundaries; compute days active by season.
visualization: Table of seasons with total days decor stayed up.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how long your seasonal decorations really stay up each year from setup to takedown.
